:::{#sol-centered-data-rank-practice}

By @thm-centered-data-rank with $n = 3$, $\rankf{\mX_c} \le 3 - 1 = 2$.
That number is smaller than $\min\cb{3, 4} = 3$ from @cor-rank-bound:
the three centered [rows](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-row) add up to $\vzero_4$,
so they are [linearly dependent](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-linearly-independent).

:::
